description: Install three.js ecosystem dependencies and create a 3D PnL graph component that shows PnL (Z-axis) vs Time (X-axis) vs OI (Y-axis) with orbit controls for rotation/pan/zoom. Integrate it into StockDetail when viewing a trade.
steps: Pass the full Trade object from App.tsx to StockDetail.tsx. Currently App.tsx only passes markStart/markEnd. Add a 'trade' prop (type Trade | null) to StockDetail's Props interface. In App.tsx where StockDetail is rendered (around line 265), add trade={tradeForView}.

Create src/PnlGraph3D.tsx component that accepts: trade (Trade), history (OiHistory), lotSize (number). This component computes 3D data points from the OI history: for each day since trade.opened_at, find the buy-leg future's close price and sell-leg future's close price at that date, compute cumulative PnL = lotSize * ((buyClose - buyEntry) + (sellEntry - sellClose)). Also get the net OI at that date (sum of both legs' OI or use buy-leg OI). The 3D axes are: X = time (index or days since open), Y = OI, Z = PnL.

Inside PnlGraph3D.tsx, render a @react-three/fiber Canvas with OrbitControls from @react-three/drei. Draw: (1) A 3D line/tube connecting the data points in order. (2) Axis labels using drei's Text component (X: Time, Y: OI, Z: PnL). (3) A grid plane or axis lines for orientation. Color the line green when PnL > 0, red when PnL < 0.

In StockDetail.tsx, import PnlGraph3D. After the existing charts section, conditionally render PnlGraph3D when the trade prop is provided and history is loaded. Wrap it in a detail-chart div with a chart-head showing '3D PnL Surface'. Give it a fixed height (e.g. 500px).
Verify that tsc -b passes with no errors and vite build succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: npm install succeeds with three, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei added to package.json dependencies
A new PnlGraph3D.tsx component exists in src/
StockDetail renders the 3D graph when a trade is active (markStart is defined and trade prop is provided)
The 3D graph has orbit controls allowing rotation, pan, and zoom
The axes represent Time (X), OI (Y), and PnL (Z)
vite build produces a bundle without errors
findings: Used @react-three/fiber@^8.17.10 and @react-three/drei@^9 instead of latest (v9.x) because the project uses React 18 and latest fiber requires React 19. Build produces a large chunk (1.2MB) due to three.js - could consider code-splitting in the future. tsc -b and vite build both pass clean.
